ingestion_note: The import workflow downloads pinned source bytes, validates PNG dimensions and SHA-256, checks ZIP CRC and safe paths, inventories/extracts PNG/PSD sources, inspects PSD layer trees, exports visible non-empty leaf layers to transparent PNGs, and publishes separate hash-pinned manifests for original PNG references and extracted PSD layers.
